title: A count in a debt note is flagged unless a check reads that number
why: Lane record-claim-cites-code (session_013NEJL33wvLc6xtDnBTJDAw): on #2063 it wrote "0 doc-relative cites among 266" into note stale010-subfolder-relative-cite; the line it added was itself a cite, so the count was wrong at once, and the failed fix check restarted the review chain.
note: Filed 10:25 CST Nov 8 from that lane (rule verification-checked-reader-for-numbers). Fix: lint flags a count in docs/debts/notes.md ("N cites", "among N") unless a check reads that number. Related: decision-count-reader (doing). 10:27 CST Nov 8 (coordinator 10:26 CST, item 386): rides in the lane that found it, as a follow-up PR with Merge after: #2063. 10:29 CST Nov 8: lane record-claim-cites-code says it is off its topic (the number-reader rule, not stale cites) and passed it to the coordinator for a new lane.
